mechanism: Prednisolone may increase fluphenazine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and additive CNS/anticholinergic effects; fluphenazine may mask signs of infection that prednisolone immunosuppression could worsen.
action: Monitor for increased extrapyramidal symptoms, anticholinergic effects, and signs of infection; ophthalmic prednisolone has minimal systemic absorption but caution advised with systemic fluphenazine use.
